# EWS HTTP conversion explicitly wraps the shared protocol error

The shared-crate extraction keeps protocol errors inside the EWS-specific wrapper. From<moz_http::Error> constructs XpComEwsError::Protocol(ProtocolError::Http(value)) directly. This avoids selecting the same From implementation again, which was the concrete recursion concern in review. Conversion to nsresult preserves an embedded XPCOM result or HTTP error result; other EWS errors use the fallback. Later shared error variants are a separate phase. This is a scoped conversion contract, not a general rule against into() in Rust.

Scope: EWS and shared protocol error conversion.
